finalText:
Migration's done. 12 files had leftover `db.query` calls — `returnService.js`, `shipment.js`, `refund.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`, and `cohort.js` — all now call `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Two things I left alone on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still uses `db.query`, since it's vendored code that gets replaced on upgrade, and the various `cache.query` calls, which are a different thing entirely and were never part of this migration. The verify script confirms everything's clean.
